content: MetaData support required for inter-ECU client server com- munication over Ethernet with clients located on different ECUs The modeling of client server interaction over Ethernet with clients located on different ECUs requires the support of COM Stack MetaData. The relationship between the call and return is achieved by means of meta data items attached to the Pdu s by the Socket Adapter.
